description: URDF joint angles (so101_new_calib.urdf, radians) <-> SO-ARM101 servo ticks for the so101_ik writing demo. tick = home_tick + sign * (q_rad - q_home_rad) * 4096 / (2*pi). home_tick comes from config/arm_home.json (arm pointing completely straight up, base facing forward, re-recorded 2026-11-08). q_home_rad is the URDF joint vector that puts the tool straight above the shoulder with the tool axis pointing up, found numerically with so101_ik.fk.urdf_chain_fk (the URDF zero is NOT straight up: at q = 0 the upper arm is 14 deg from vertical and the forearm points forward horizontally, so straight-up needs elbow_flex -1.287 rad and shoulder_lift -0.244 rad). Nothing here was measured on the arm except the shoulder_lift tick direction.

shoulder_pan.note: URDF pan axis is -z of the base, so positive q turns the arm clockwise seen from above (to the robot's right). Unchecked which tick direction that is. Direction verified 2026-11-08 (smooth +150-tick sweep, final reading seen from above): base turned clockwise = +URDF pan, sign +1. Cross-check at the first hover point: the pen must be at the text start, on the robot's left seen from behind.
shoulder_pan.how_to_verify: Smooth sweep (so101_ik.joint_sweep) of +150 ticks turned the base clockwise seen from above (verified 2026-11-08). Home tick 1967 = base facing forward.

shoulder_lift.note: Direction checked on the arm (neural_reflex/pick_sim.py FORWARD_TICK_SIGN, config/robot_map.json): larger ticks tilt the arm forward/down from straight up. In the URDF positive shoulder_lift rotates about +y of the base, which also tilts the upper arm toward +x (forward), hence sign +1. q_home_rad itself is only the URDF estimate of the straight-up pose. Direction verified on the arm 2026-11-07 (larger ticks tilt forward).
shoulder_lift.how_to_verify: Larger ticks tilt the arm forward from straight up (verified on the arm). Home tick 2046 = straight up; +45 deg forward reads about 2558.

elbow_flex.note: Home is 217 ticks above the motor minimum and 2021 below the maximum; in the URDF the straight-up elbow (-1.287 rad) is 0.40 rad above the lower limit and 2.98 rad below the upper one, so bending forward must increase ticks (sign +1). The ratio matches (217 ticks = 0.33 rad). Direction verified 2026-11-08: +80 ticks tipped the forearm forward.
elbow_flex.how_to_verify: +80 ticks tipped the forearm forward (verified 2026-11-08). Home tick 936 = straight; forearm horizontal reads about 1960.

wrist_flex.note: GEOMETRY-INFERRED, NOT MEASURED. The motor range is asymmetric about home: 1199 ticks (105 deg) below, 795 ticks (70 deg) above. Writing with the pen straight down at the table needs the hand bent 75..90 deg forward from straight (URDF wrist_flex +1.3..+1.6 rad; the upper arm is too short for any solution with less bend), which only fits the motor range if bending forward DEcreases ticks. With sign +1 the plan maps to ~2850..3040 ticks, above the 2740 maximum, and write_arm refuses it. Check this sign before the first --execute; if it is really +1, the arm cannot write with the pen vertical and the plan needs a tilted pen. Direction verified 2026-11-08 by hand with torque off: tilting the handle ~13 deg toward the front read 1950 from a 2100 home, so smaller ticks = forward, sign -1 (an earlier eyeball reading of a 7-deg nudge said the opposite and was wrong).
wrist_flex.how_to_verify: Tilting the handle forward by hand with torque off LOWERED the ticks (2100 -> 1950 for ~13 deg), so sign is -1 (verified 2026-11-08). +45 deg forward reads about 1588.

wrist_roll.note: Roll is left free by the pen task, so the plan keeps it near 0 rad = home ticks; its sign barely matters for writing. Direction verified 2026-11-08: +150 ticks spun the handle counter-clockwise seen from above (arm straight up) = +URDF roll, sign +1.
wrist_roll.how_to_verify: +150 ticks spun the handle counter-clockwise seen from above with the arm straight up (verified 2026-11-08). Home tick 1039; roll is held at home during writing so its sign never enters.

notes_2026-11-08: Home re-recorded with the arm set straight by eye. Live finding: the leader arm's shoulder servo stalls when writing 20 cm from the base (44% load, 88-tick lag -> controller fault). Writing 13 cm from the base with 2 cm letters plus a rubber-band gravity assist on the upper arm completed 'hello Neo' (run data/runs/write-20261108-024633.jsonl) with max lag shoulder 52 / elbow 63 ticks.
